messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Ever wondered how I find all the things that other players lost? I outsource it. Right now, someone is looking for their %1$s. Can you find that for me?
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 想过我是怎么找回其他玩家丢失的东西的吗? 我外包了。现在有人正在找他们的%1$s。你能替我找来吗?

messages.text: There we go, a job well done. I'll make sure to leave a good review for you!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 这就对了,活干得漂亮。我一定会给你留个好评!

messages.text: Turns out, if you want something done, you have to do it yourself.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 看来想把事情办成,还是得亲自来。
